tools.name: capability_search
tools.description: Find the action for a job, by the person's own words ("work email of a person", "dentists in a city") or by an action id. Use it first for any one-off data job. When a ready-made recipe fits the ask, the answer offers it first. Each result has its id, what it gives, whether it is ready and its price

tools.name: capability_inspect
tools.description: One action by its id: its inputs, what it gives and its price rule. With arguments (the person's real inputs) it also prices that exact run: the most it can cost, what it usually costs, the balance, and a consent sentence to read to the person. Nothing runs and nothing is charged. With rows or rows_

tools.description: Run one action, after the person agreed to the price capability_inspect gave. Give id, arguments and max_cost_usd from that price: a run that would cost more is refused with nothing charged. Only a delivered result is charged; a run that finds nothing costs nothing. tools.description: Ask Ahel to add an action the catalog does not have, when capability_search finds nothing that fits. Give the job in plain words, one example input, and the most the person would pay for one run. Asking again adds to the same request. Free; runs and charges nothing. tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Tell Ahel what went wrong or right: rate one run or request good or bad by its id, or with no id report anything confusing (results, charges, instructions, errors, a workaround you needed). Report small annoyances too. Leave out private information and keys. Free. NOT for: reading a run, which is ca

tools.name: balance
tools.description: The workspace's prepaid balance, what running jobs have set aside, spending today and this month (for the Owner), any daily cap on this connection's key, and the top-up link. Use it when a run is refused for funds or before a large job. Free. NOT for: the price of one run, which is capability_inspec

tools.name: review
tools.description: Rate how useful one finished run was, after using its result: useful, partly, not_useful or not_sure, with an optional reason (missing rows, wrong data, stale). Reviewing again replaces the earlier one. Free. NOT for: reporting a problem, which is feedback.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Start here when the person is new, asks what Ahel can do, or has no clear job yet. Answers what Ahel does in plain words, the ready-made recipes to offer first, how paying works, and a question to ask the person. Free; changes nothing. NOT for: a clear one-off job, which is capability_search.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.ahel.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, run_recipe · Private data: run_recipe, capability_run_status, feedback · Public sink: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, run_recipe · Destructive: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, run_batch, run_recipe, capability_run_status, catalog_request, feedback, balance, review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, run_recipe · Private data: run_recipe, capability_run_status, feedback · Public sink: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, run_recipe · Destructive: capability_search, capability_inspect, run_capability, run_batch, run_recipe, capability_run_status, catalog_request, feedback, balance, review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "run_recipe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run a recipe: a ready-made job of several actions, such as local businesses of one kind in one place with their emails (or only those with weak reviews), a company list with industry, size and register entry, checked work emails for a list of people, a brief on a company and a person before a call, " → after: "Run a recipe: a ready-made job of several actions, such as local businesses of one kind in one place with their emails (or only those with weak reviews), new companies with contacts or companies with a reason to call now in any country (contracts, new registrations, funding or hiring, with a signal "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
